links.outcome: Clinical appropriateness of LLM-generated anaesthetic plans versus consultants and adjudication committee
links.effect: Plans showed variable agreement with consultants; inappropriate recommendations included subpar postoperative pain management and failure to recommend tracheal intubation for patients at high risk of aspiration.
links.quote: While some differences were not deemed clinically significant, subpar postoperative pain management advice and failure to recommend tracheal intubation for patients at high risk for pulmonary aspiration were considered inappropriate recommendations.

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM answers across repeated prompts
links.effect: ChatGPT answers were repetitive and lacked variety, with inconsistent choices on airway management, postoperative analgesia, and medication use.
links.quote: It also showed inconsistent choices regarding airway management, postoperative analgesia, and medication use.

screen.reason: Evaluated the quality, validity, and safety of ChatGPT-4.0 in generating preoperative anaesthetic plans on 10 clinical vignettes compared to senior anaesthesia consultants.
